title: Progression gating and traffic triage for active-passive cutover
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Author a detailed progression-gated cutover procedure that emphasizes priority-aware traffic triage, circuit-breaker choreography, and atomic verification of backup/restore integrity for active->passive DR drills. The runbook must be executable by on-call engineers and SREs with clear decision gates tied to SLOs and observable thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A step-by-step cutover checklist that can be executed in under 90 minutes for a scoped service boundary
Automated verification steps for backups (checksum, schema, sample-key reads) and full-restore smoke tests that complete within defined windows
SLO-driven gating thresholds documented and wired into the drill play (latency P95/P99, error-rate, token-throttle rate)
Circuit-breaker parameter recipes (open/half-open durations, hysteresis) and corresponding load-shedding rules per priority class
Observable dashboards and canary probes (synthetic traffic) with playbook links available in the Console and on-call pager configuration
Post-drill forensic checklist and a template for incident review produced automatically after each drill
cutover_steps: Pre-drill org-wide announcement and pager duty notification (T-minus 48h and T-minus 2h)
Confirm backup snapshot integrity: compare snapshot checksum, object counts, and manifest signature against baseline
Warm-up passive region: stage model weights, cold KV cache fill to 10% steady-state; run compatibility smoke on quantized kernels
Stage 1 - Non-critical traffic siphon (5-minute window): divert 1% of non-production traffic routed by tag to passive region; monitor latency P95 < SLO-1 and error-rate < SLO-ERR-LOW
Gate decision 1: If SLOs met and no new errors > threshold, proceed to Stage 2. If gate fails, run automatic rollback to active and escalate to on-call SRE

Stage 2 - Priority-aware triage: shift only P3/P2 traffic classes to passive and enable conservative circuit-breaker profile (open threshold 10% errors, half-open after 60s), continue synthetic checks

Stage 3 - Progressive promotion: increment traffic in 10% steps every 10 minutes for P1 traffic while maintaining cache warmup; at each step validate response signatures and evaluation prompts against baseline samples
Atomic switch: when 95% of P1 traffic and all P2/P3 are validated, flip primary routing DNS with low TTL and enable read-after-write validation hooks for critical KV paths
Post-cutover verification: run full service smoke suite, cross-region data consistency checks, and token-store integrity asserts; capture telemetry snapshot for forensic comparison
Rollback procedure: automated circuit-breaker-triggered siphon back to active region, invalidate passive DNS entries, run rollback smoke and resume normal monitoring
backup_and_restore_validation: Snapshot sanity: manifest signature verification, object count delta < 0.1% from baseline
Checksum verification: SHA256 of snapshot objects compared with last successful snapshot; fail if any mismatch
Sample-key validation: run targeted GET/READs against a stratified sample of keys (hot, warm, cold) and assert read-after-write consistency
Restore smoke: restore metadata and a 5% data tranche to a test cluster, run API smoke suite and eval prompts against golden outputs
Time-to-restore budget: full restore of scoped dataset must be < 45 minutes for drill success at this service tier
Rollback verification after restore: check that indices, feature flags, and per-tenant routing rules match pre-restore manifests
slo_and_observability_gates: Primary SLOs: P95 generation latency < 200ms, P99 < 800ms, error-rate < 0.5% for production traffic
Drill-specific gates: synthetic success-rate >= 99.5% and end-to-end median latency within 1.5x baseline
Circuit-breaker telemetry: open-count, open-duration, half-open success ratio must be captured and surfaced
Roll-forward/rollback thresholds: defined error-rate spike (>2x baseline) sustained for 3 minutes triggers rollback gate
Dashboards: pre-configured Console view with token-level cost, per-route latency, request hedging counts, and KV integrity checks
Automated alerts: Slack and PagerDuty hooks for gate failure, backup checksum mismatch, or restore duration breach
circuit_breaker_and_load_shedding_recipe: Conservative profile (during Stage 1-2): open at 8% error-rate, reset backoff 90s, allow 5 traffic retries with exponential jitter
Aggressive profile (emergency): open at 3% error-rate and immediately shed P3/P2 traffic using token-based rate limiter
Half-open probing: allow 1% of prior QPS as probe traffic for 30s then evaluate success ratio (>95%) before fully closing
Priority classes: P1 (critical), P2 (important), P3 (best-effort). Load-shedding order: P3 -> P2 -> P1. Implement graceful 429 responses with informative Retry-After headers and fallback guidance
Backpressure signals: tie circuit-breaker events to autoscaler decisions to prevent thrashing (min cooldown 120s)
telemetry_and_post_drill_forensics: Collect baseline and drill telemetry snapshot (token counts, per-route latency histograms, KV read/write latencies)
Generate automated diffs vs previous successful drill for latency, error-rate, and cost-per-token
Forensic traces: capture end-to-end traces for a stratified sample of failed and succeeded requests and attach to the drill ticket
Post-drill deliverable: 1-page executive summary and a technical AAR (what failed, why, action items) within 72 hours
Retention policy: keep drill artifacts (snapshots, manifests, trace bundles) for 90 days for follow-up audits

postmortem_template: Summary: one-paragraph summary of what happened and customer impact
Timeline: minute-level timeline of key events and gate decisions
Root cause analysis: technical cause and decision root causes
Mitigations and follow-ups: prioritized action items, owners, and deadlines
Metrics: attach pre/post diffs for SLOs, error-rates, and cost delta
